																																																																																																																																																																																												# Mount the disk
																																																																																																																																																																																												sudo mount /dev/sdc /mnt/nautilus-disk

																																																																																																																																																																																												# Persist via UUID in fstab (more reliable than device name)
																																																																																																																																																																																												UUID=$(sudo blkid /dev/sdc -s UUID -o value)
																																																																																																																																																																																												echo "UUID: $UUID"
																																																																																																																																																																																												echo "UUID=$UUID /mnt/nautilus-disk ext4 defaults,nofail 0 2" | sudo tee -a /etc/fstab

																																																																																																																																																																																												echo "=== Verification ==="
																																																																																																																																																																																												df -h /mnt/nautilus-disk
																																																																																																																																																																																												lsblk
																																																																																																																																																																																												grep nautilus-disk /etc/fstab

																																																																																																																																																																																												ENDSSH
																																																																																																																																																																																												```

																																																																																																																																																																																												### 10. Final Verification from Azure Side
																																																																																																																																																																																												```bash
																																																																																																																																																																																												# Verify disk sizes from Azure
																																																																																																																																																																																												az disk list \
																																																																																																																																																																																												    --resource-group kml_rg_main-dd8c8488e6b144b2 \
																																																																																																																																																																																												        --query "[].{Name:name, SizeGB:diskSizeGb, SKU:sku.name}" \
																																																																																																																																																																																													    -o table

																																																																																																																																																																																													    # Confirm mount from inside VM
																																																																																																																																																																																													    ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_rsa -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no azureuser@$PUBLIC_IP \
																																																																																																																																																																																													        "df -h /mnt/nautilus-disk && lsblk && grep nautilus-disk /etc/fstab"
																																																																																																																																																																																														```

																																																																																																																																																																																														---

																																																																																																																																																																																														## Issues Encountered & Fixes

																																																																																																																																																																																														| Issue | Cause | Fix |
																																																																																																																																																																																														|---|---|---|
																																																																																																																																																																																														| Auto-detect script picked `/dev/sda` instead of `/dev/sdc` | Both `sda` (OS) and `sdc` (data) show as 64G after resize — script matched wrong disk | Hardcoded `/dev/sdc` after confirming via `lsblk` output |
																																																																																																																																																																																														| Empty UUID in fstab entry | Format failed silently because wrong disk (`/dev/sda`) was targeted | Fixed device to `/dev/sdc`, UUID populated correctly |
																																																																																																																																																																																														| First task attempt failed validation | Mount not completed — disk was attached but never formatted/mounted inside VM | Re-ran the SSH heredoc with correct device `/dev/sdc` |

																																																																																																																																																																																														---

																																																																																																																																																																																														## Verification Output

																																																																																																																																																																																														```
																																																																																																																																																																																														Filesystem      Size  Used Avail Use% Mounted on
																																																																																																																																																																																														/dev/sdc         63G   24K   60G   1% /mnt/nautilus-disk

																																																																																																																																																																																														NAME    SIZE  TYPE  MOUNTPOINTS
																																																																																																																																																																																														sda      64G  disk
																																																																																																																																																																																														├─sda1  63.9G part  /
																																																																																																																																																																																														sdc      64G  disk  /mnt/nautilus-disk

																																																																																																																																																																																														UUID=c021dc30-b67d-4a0a-825f-3c32654e7f8e /mnt/nautilus-disk ext4 defaults,nofail 0 2
																																																																																																																																																																																														```

																																																																																																																																																																																														| Item | Value |
																																																																																																																																																																																														|---|---|
																																																																																																																																																																																														| OS Disk | Resized from 32GB → 64GB ✅ |
																																																																																																																																																																																														| Data Disk | `nautilus-disk` 64GB Standard_LRS ✅ |
																																																																																																																																																																																														| Mount Point | `/mnt/nautilus-disk` ✅ |
																																																																																																																																																																																														| Filesystem | ext4 ✅ |
																																																																																																																																																																																														| fstab Entry | UUID-based, persistent ✅ |

																																																																																																																																																																																														---

																																																																																																																																																																																														## Key Concepts

																																																																																																																																																																																														**Why Deallocate Before Resizing OS Disk?**
																																																																																																																																																																																														Azure does not allow resizing a disk that is actively in use by a running VM. The VM must be fully deallocated (not just stopped) to release the disk lock. After resizing, restart the VM normally.

																																																																																																																																																																																														**Why Use UUID in `/etc/fstab` Instead of `/dev/sdc`?**
																																																																																																																																																																																														Device names like `/dev/sdc` can change between reboots depending on the order disks are detected. UUIDs are permanent identifiers tied to the filesystem itself and never change, making them the reliable way to persist mounts.

																																																																																																																																																																																														**Why `nofail` in fstab?**
																																																																																																																																																																																														The `nofail` option prevents the VM from failing to boot if the disk is somehow not available (e.g. detached). This is especially important for data disks on cloud VMs.

																																																																																																																																																																																														**Why Hardcode `/dev/sdc` Instead of Auto-Detecting?**
																																																																																																																																																																																														Auto-detection by size failed in this task because after resizing the OS disk to 64GB, both `sda` and `sdc` appeared as 64G in `lsblk`. Always verify the correct device with `lsblk` and look for the disk with **no partitions and no mountpoint** — that is the newly attached data disk.# Task 25 — Expand VM OS Disk and Add Data Disk

																																																																																																																																																																																														## Overview

																																																																																																																																																																																														The Nautilus DevOps Team needed to expand the storage capacity of an existing virtual machine `nautilus-vm` to support increased workloads. This involved two operations: resizing the existing OS disk from 32GB to 64GB, and creating and mounting a new 64GB Standard HDD data disk named `nautilus-disk` at `/mnt/nautilus-disk`.

																																																																																																																																																																																														---

																																																																																																																																																																																														## Requirements

																																																																																																																																																																																														| Parameter | Value |
																																																																																																																																																																																														|---|---|
																																																																																																																																																																																														| VM Name | `nautilus-vm` |
																																																																																																																																																																																														| OS Disk Resize | 32GB → 64GB |
																																																																																																																																																																																														| New Data Disk Name | `nautilus-disk` |
																																																																																																																																																																																														| New Data Disk Size | 64GB |
																																																																																																																																																																																														| New Data Disk Type | Standard HDD (`Standard_LRS`) |
																																																																																																																																																																																														| Mount Point | `/mnt/nautilus-disk` |
																																																																																																																																																																																														| Filesystem | ext4 |
																																																																																																																																																																																														| Mount Persistence | Yes (via `/etc/fstab`) |
																																																																																																																																																																																														| Region | East US |

																																																																																																																																																																																														---

																																																																																																																																																																																														## Prerequisites

																																																																																																																																																																																														- Azure CLI installed and configured on the azure-client host
																																																																																																																																																																																														- `nautilus-vm` already exists and is running
																																																																																																																																																																																														- SSH key `~/.ssh/id_rsa` available on azure-client

																																																																																																																																																																																														---

																																																																																																																																																																																														## Steps Performed

																																																																																																																																																																																														### 1. Login to Azure
																																																																																																																																																																																														```bash
																																																																																																																																																																																														az login -u "<username>" -p "<password>"
																																																																																																																																																																																														az group list --output table
																																																																																																																																																																																														```

																																																																																																																																																																																														### 2. Get Current OS Disk Details
																																																																																																																																																																																														```bash
																																																																																																																																																																																														az vm show \
																																																																																																																																																																																														    --resource-group kml_rg_main-dd8c8488e6b144b2 \
																																																																																																																																																																																														        --name nautilus-vm \
																																																																																																																																																																																															    --query "{OSDisk:storageProfile.osDisk.name, Size:storageProfile.osDisk.diskSizeGb, Location:location}" \
																																																																																																																																																																																															        -o table
																																																																																																																																																																																																```

																																																																																																																																																																																																Output confirmed:
																																																																																																																																																																																																```
																																																																																																																																																																																																OSDisk                                              Size    Location
																																																																																																																																																																																																--------------------------------------------------  ------  ----------
																																																																																																																																																																																																nautilus-vm_disk1_1eb3ee0318e740c38b784c6b645efb2b  32      eastus
																																																																																																																																																																																																```

																																																																																																																																																																																																### 3. Deallocate VM (Required Before Resizing OS Disk)
																																																																																																																																																																																																```bash
																																																																																																																																																																																																az vm deallocate \
																																																																																																																																																																																																    --resource-group kml_rg_main-dd8c8488e6b144b2 \
																																																																																																																																																																																																        --name nautilus-vm

																																																																																																																																																																																																	echo "VM deallocated"
																																																																																																																																																																																																	```

																																																																																																																																																																																																	> **Important:** Azure requires the VM to be in a deallocated (stopped) state before resizing the OS disk. Simply stopping the VM is not enough — it must be fully deallocated.

																																																																																																																																																																																																	### 4. Resize the OS Disk to 64GB
																																																																																																																																																																																																	```bash
																																																																																																																																																																																																	OS_DISK=$(az vm show \
																																																																																																																																																																																																	    --resource-group kml_rg_main-dd8c8488e6b144b2 \
																																																																																																																																																																																																	        --name nautilus-vm \
																																																																																																																																																																																																		    --query "storageProfile.osDisk.name" -o tsv)

																																																																																																																																																																																																		    echo "OS Disk name: $OS_DISK"

																																																																																																																																																																																																		    az disk update \
																																																																																																																																																																																																		        --resource-group kml_rg_main-dd8c8488e6b144b2 \
																																																																																																																																																																																																			    --name $OS_DISK \
																																																																																																																																																																																																			        --size-gb 64

																																																																																																																																																																																																				echo "OS disk resized to 64GB"
																																																																																																																																																																																																				```

																																																																																																																																																																																																				### 5. Create New Standard HDD Data Disk
																																																																																																																																																																																																				```bash
																																																																																																																																																																																																				VM_LOCATION=$(az vm show \
																																																																																																																																																																																																				    --resource-group kml_rg_main-dd8c8488e6b144b2 \
																																																																																																																																																																																																				        --name nautilus-vm \
																																																																																																																																																																																																					    --query location -o tsv)

																																																																																																																																																																																																					    echo "VM Location: $VM_LOCATION"

																																																																																																																																																																																																					    az disk create \
																																																																																																																																																																																																					        --resource-group kml_rg_main-dd8c8488e6b144b2 \
																																																																																																																																																																																																						    --name nautilus-disk \
																																																																																																																																																																																																						        --size-gb 64 \
																																																																																																																																																																																																							    --sku Standard_LRS \
																																																																																																																																																																																																							        --location $VM_LOCATION
																																																																																																																																																																																																								```

																																																																																																																																																																																																								> Using `$VM_LOCATION` dynamically ensures the disk is created in the same region as the VM — required for attachment.

																																																																																																																																																																																																								### 6. Attach Data Disk to VM
																																																																																																																																																																																																								```bash
																																																																																																																																																																																																								az vm disk attach \
																																																																																																																																																																																																								    --resource-group kml_rg_main-dd8c8488e6b144b2 \
																																																																																																																																																																																																								        --vm-name nautilus-vm \
																																																																																																																																																																																																									    --name nautilus-disk

																																																																																																																																																																																																									    echo "Data disk attached"
																																																																																																																																																																																																									    ```

																																																																																																																																																																																																									    ### 7. Start the VM
																																																																																																																																																																																																									    ```bash
																																																																																																																																																																																																									    az vm start \
																																																																																																																																																																																																									        --resource-group kml_rg_main-dd8c8488e6b144b2 \
																																																																																																																																																																																																										    --name nautilus-vm

																																																																																																																																																																																																										    az vm wait \
																																																																																																																																																																																																										        --resource-group kml_rg_main-dd8c8488e6b144b2 \
																																																																																																																																																																																																											    --name nautilus-vm \
																																																																																																																																																																																																											        --updated

																																																																																																																																																																																																												echo "VM is running"
																																																																																																																																																																																																												```

																																																																																																																																																																																																												### 8. Get Public IP
																																																																																																																																																																																																												```bash
																																																																																																																																																																																																												PUBLIC_IP=$(az vm show \
																																																																																																																																																																																																												    --resource-group kml_rg_main-dd8c8488e6b144b2 \
																																																																																																																																																																																																												        --name nautilus-vm \
																																																																																																																																																																																																													    --show-details \
																																																																																																																																																																																																													        --query publicIps -o tsv)

																																																																																																																																																																																																														echo "Public IP: $PUBLIC_IP"
																																																																																																																																																																																																														```

																																																																																																																																																																																																														### 9. Format, Mount and Persist the Data Disk via Remote SSH
																																																																																																																																																																																																														```bash
																																																																																																																																																																																																														ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_rsa \
																																																																																																																																																																																																														    -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no \
																																																																																																																																																																																																														        azureuser@$PUBLIC_IP << 'ENDSSH'

																																																																																																																																																																																																															echo "=== Disk layout ==="
																																																																																																																																																																																																															lsblk

																																																																																																																																																																																																															# Format the correct disk /dev/sdc (confirmed via lsblk)
																																																																																																																																																																																																															sudo mkfs.ext4 -F /dev/sdc

																																																																																																																																																																																																															# Create mount point
																																																																																																																																																																																																															sudo mkdir -p /mnt/nautilus-disk

																																																																																																																																																																																																															# Mount the disk
																																																																																																																																																																																																															sudo mount /dev/sdc /mnt/nautilus-disk

																																																																																																																																																																																																															# Persist via UUID in fstab (more reliable than device name)
																																																																																																																																																																																																															UUID=$(sudo blkid /dev/sdc -s UUID -o value)
																																																																																																																																																																																																															echo "UUID: $UUID"
																																																																																																																																																																																																															echo "UUID=$UUID /mnt/nautilus-disk ext4 defaults,nofail 0 2" | sudo tee -a /etc/fstab

																																																																																																																																																																																																															echo "=== Verification ==="
																																																																																																																																																																																																															df -h /mnt/nautilus-disk
																																																																																																																																																																																																															lsblk
																																																																																																																																																																																																															grep nautilus-disk /etc/fstab

																																																																																																																																																																																																															ENDSSH
																																																																																																																																																																																																															```

																																																																																																																																																																																																															### 10. Final Verification from Azure Side
																																																																																																																																																																																																															```bash
																																																																																																																																																																																																															# Verify disk sizes from Azure
																																																																																																																																																																																																															az disk list \
																																																																																																																																																																																																															    --resource-group kml_rg_main-dd8c8488e6b144b2 \
																																																																																																																																																																																																															        --query "[].{Name:name, SizeGB:diskSizeGb, SKU:sku.name}" \
																																																																																																																																																																																																																    -o table

																																																																																																																																																																																																																    # Confirm mount from inside VM
																																																																																																																																																																																																																    ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_rsa -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no azureuser@$PUBLIC_IP \
																																																																																																																																																																																																																        "df -h /mnt/nautilus-disk && lsblk && grep nautilus-disk /etc/fstab"
																																																																																																																																																																																																																	```

																																																																																																																																																																																																																	---

																																																																																																																																																																																																																	## Issues Encountered & Fixes

																																																																																																																																																																																																																	| Issue | Cause | Fix |
																																																																																																																																																																																																																	|---|---|---|
																																																																																																																																																																																																																	| Auto-detect script picked `/dev/sda` instead of `/dev/sdc` | Both `sda` (OS) and `sdc` (data) show as 64G after resize — script matched wrong disk | Hardcoded `/dev/sdc` after confirming via `lsblk` output |
																																																																																																																																																																																																																	| Empty UUID in fstab entry | Format failed silently because wrong disk (`/dev/sda`) was targeted | Fixed device to `/dev/sdc`, UUID populated correctly |
																																																																																																																																																																																																																	| First task attempt failed validation | Mount not completed — disk was attached but never formatted/mounted inside VM | Re-ran the SSH heredoc with correct device `/dev/sdc` |

																																																																																																																																																																																																																	---

																																																																																																																																																																																																																	## Verification Output

																																																																																																																																																																																																																	```
																																																																																																																																																																																																																	Filesystem      Size  Used Avail Use% Mounted on
																																																																																																																																																																																																																	/dev/sdc         63G   24K   60G   1% /mnt/nautilus-disk

																																																																																																																																																																																																																	NAME    SIZE  TYPE  MOUNTPOINTS
																																																																																																																																																																																																																	sda      64G  disk
																																																																																																																																																																																																																	├─sda1  63.9G part  /
																																																																																																																																																																																																																	sdc      64G  disk  /mnt/nautilus-disk

																																																																																																																																																																																																																	UUID=c021dc30-b67d-4a0a-825f-3c32654e7f8e /mnt/nautilus-disk ext4 defaults,nofail 0 2
																																																																																																																																																																																																																	```

																																																																																																																																																																																																																	| Item | Value |
																																																																																																																																																																																																																	|---|---|
																																																																																																																																																																																																																	| OS Disk | Resized from 32GB → 64GB ✅ |
																																																																																																																																																																																																																	| Data Disk | `nautilus-disk` 64GB Standard_LRS ✅ |
																																																																																																																																																																																																																	| Mount Point | `/mnt/nautilus-disk` ✅ |
																																																																																																																																																																																																																	| Filesystem | ext4 ✅ |
																																																																																																																																																																																																																	| fstab Entry | UUID-based, persistent ✅ |

																																																																																																																																																																																																																	---

																																																																																																																																																																																																																	## Key Concepts

																																																																																																																																																																																																																	**Why Deallocate Before Resizing OS Disk?**
																																																																																																																																																																																																																	Azure does not allow resizing a disk that is actively in use by a running VM. The VM must be fully deallocated (not just stopped) to release the disk lock. After resizing, restart the VM normally.

																																																																																																																																																																																																																	**Why Use UUID in `/etc/fstab` Instead of `/dev/sdc`?**
																																																																																																																																																																																																																	Device names like `/dev/sdc` can change between reboots depending on the order disks are detected. UUIDs are permanent identifiers tied to the filesystem itself and never change, making them the reliable way to persist mounts.

																																																																																																																																																																																																																	**Why `nofail` in fstab?**
																																																																																																																																																																																																																	The `nofail` option prevents the VM from failing to boot if the disk is somehow not available (e.g. detached). This is especially important for data disks on cloud VMs.

																																																																																																																																																																																																																	**Why Hardcode `/dev/sdc` Instead of Auto-Detecting?**
																																																																																																																																																																																																																	Auto-detection by size failed in this task because after resizing the OS disk to 64GB, both `sda` and `sdc` appeared as 64G in `lsblk`. Always verify the correct device with `lsblk` and look for the disk with **no partitions and no mountpoint** — that is the newly attached data disk.# Task 25 — Expand VM OS Disk and Add Data Disk

																																																																																																																																																																																																																	## Overview

																																																																																																																																																																																																																	The Nautilus DevOps Team needed to expand the storage capacity of an existing virtual machine `nautilus-vm` to support increased workloads. This involved two operations: resizing the existing OS disk from 32GB to 64GB, and creating and mounting a new 64GB Standard HDD data disk named `nautilus-disk` at `/mnt/nautilus-disk`.

																																																																																																																																																																																																																	---

																																																																																																																																																																																																																	## Requirements

																																																																																																																																																																																																																	| Parameter | Value |
																																																																																																																																																																																																																	|---|---|
																																																																																																																																																																																																																	| VM Name | `nautilus-vm` |
																																																																																																																																																																																																																	| OS Disk Resize | 32GB → 64GB |
																																																																																																																																																																																																																	| New Data Disk Name | `nautilus-disk` |
																																																																																																																																																																																																																	| New Data Disk Size | 64GB |
																																																																																																																																																																																																																	| New Data Disk Type | Standard HDD (`Standard_LRS`) |
																																																																																																																																																																																																																	| Mount Point | `/mnt/nautilus-disk` |
																																																																																																																																																																																																																	| Filesystem | ext4 |
																																																																																																																																																																																																																	| Mount Persistence | Yes (via `/etc/fstab`) |
																																																																																																																																																																																																																	| Region | East US |

																																																																																																																																																																																																																	---

																																																																																																																																																																																																																	## Prerequisites

																																																																																																																																																																																																																	- Azure CLI installed and configured on the azure-client host
																																																																																																																																																																																																																	- `nautilus-vm` already exists and is running
																																																																																																																																																																																																																	- SSH key `~/.ssh/id_rsa` available on azure-client

																																																																																																																																																																																																																	---

																																																																																																																																																																																																																	## Steps Performed

																																																																																																																																																																																																																	### 1. Login to Azure
																																																																																																																																																																																																																	```bash
																																																																																																																																																																																																																	az login -u "<username>" -p "<password>"
																																																																																																																																																																																																																	az group list --output table
																																																																																																																																																																																																																	```

																																																																																																																																																																																																																	### 2. Get Current OS Disk Details
																																																																																																																																																																																																																	```bash
																																																																																																																																																																																																																	az vm show \
																																																																																																																																																																																																																	    --resource-group kml_rg_main-dd8c8488e6b144b2 \
																																																																																																																																																																																																																	        --name nautilus-vm \
																																																																																																																																																																																																																		    --query "{OSDisk:storageProfile.osDisk.name, Size:storageProfile.osDisk.diskSizeGb, Location:location}" \
																																																																																																																																																																																																																		        -o table
																																																																																																																																																																																																																			```

																																																																																																																																																																																																																			Output confirmed:
																																																																																																																																																																																																																			```
																																																																																																																																																																																																																			OSDisk                                              Size    Location
																																																																																																																																																																																																																			--------------------------------------------------  ------  ----------
																																																																																																																																																																																																																			nautilus-vm_disk1_1eb3ee0318e740c38b784c6b645efb2b  32      eastus
																																																																																																																																																																																																																			```

																																																																																																																																																																																																																			### 3. Deallocate VM (Required Before Resizing OS Disk)
																																																																																																																																																																																																																			```bash
																																																																																																																																																																																																																			az vm deallocate \
																																																																																																																																																																																																																			    --resource-group kml_rg_main-dd8c8488e6b144b2 \
																																																																																																																																																																																																																			        --name nautilus-vm

																																																																																																																																																																																																																				echo "VM deallocated"
																																																																																																																																																																																																																				```

																																																																																																																																																																																																																				> **Important:** Azure requires the VM to be in a deallocated (stopped) state before resizing the OS disk. Simply stopping the VM is not enough — it must be fully deallocated.

																																																																																																																																																																																																																				### 4. Resize the OS Disk to 64GB
																																																																																																																																																																																																																				```bash
																																																																																																																																																																																																																				OS_DISK=$(az vm show \
																																																																																																																																																																																																																				    --resource-group kml_rg_main-dd8c8488e6b144b2 \
																																																																																																																																																																																																																				        --name nautilus-vm \
																																																																																																																																																																																																																					    --query "storageProfile.osDisk.name" -o tsv)

																																																																																																																																																																																																																					    echo "OS Disk name: $OS_DISK"

																																																																																																																																																																																																																					    az disk update \
																																																																																																																																																																																																																					        --resource-group kml_rg_main-dd8c8488e6b144b2 \
																																																																																																																																																																																																																						    --name $OS_DISK \
																																																																																																																																																																																																																						        --size-gb 64

																																																																																																																																																																																																																							echo "OS disk resized to 64GB"
																																																																																																																																																																																																																							```

																																																																																																																																																																																																																							### 5. Create New Standard HDD Data Disk
																																																																																																																																																																																																																							```bash
																																																																																																																																																																																																																							VM_LOCATION=$(az vm show \
																																																																																																																																																																																																																							    --resource-group kml_rg_main-dd8c8488e6b144b2 \
																																																																																																																																																																																																																							        --name nautilus-vm \
																																																																																																																																																																																																																								    --query location -o tsv)

																																																																																																																																																																																																																								    echo "VM Location: $VM_LOCATION"

																																																																																																																																																																																																																								    az disk create \
																																																																																																																																																																																																																								        --resource-group kml_rg_main-dd8c8488e6b144b2 \
																																																																																																																																																																																																																									    --name nautilus-disk \
																																																																																																																																																																																																																									        --size-gb 64 \
																																																																																																																																																																																																																										    --sku Standard_LRS \
																																																																																																																																																																																																																										        --location $VM_LOCATION
																																																																																																																																																																																																																											```

																																																																																																																																																																																																																											> Using `$VM_LOCATION` dynamically ensures the disk is created in the same region as the VM — required for attachment.

																																																																																																																																																																																																																											### 6. Attach Data Disk to VM
																																																																																																																																																																																																																											```bash
																																																																																																																																																																																																																											az vm disk attach \
																																																																																																																																																																																																																											    --resource-group kml_rg_main-dd8c8488e6b144b2 \
																																																																																																																																																																																																																											        --vm-name nautilus-vm \
																																																																																																																																																																																																																												    --name nautilus-disk

																																																																																																																																																																																																																												    echo "Data disk attached"
																																																																																																																																																																																																																												    ```

																																																																																																																																																																																																																												    ### 7. Start the VM
																																																																																																																																																																																																																												    ```bash
																																																																																																																																																																																																																												    az vm start \
																																																																																																																																																																																																																												        --resource-group kml_rg_main-dd8c8488e6b144b2 \
																																																																																																																																																																																																																													    --name nautilus-vm

																																																																																																																																																																																																																													    az vm wait \
																																																																																																																																																																																																																													        --resource-group kml_rg_main-dd8c8488e6b144b2 \
																																																																																																																																																																																																																														    --name nautilus-vm \
																																																																																																																																																																																																																														        --updated

																																																																																																																																																																																																																															echo "VM is running"
																																																																																																																																																																																																																															```

																																																																																																																																																																																																																															### 8. Get Public IP
